notes.title: Announcing SpinWave Survivors!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I am thrilled to announce SpinWave: Survivors, a solo project with a new take on the survival shooter genre that focuses on speed and lining up shots to maximise your damage. SpinWave: Survivors is built around scoot, shoot and boost as you blast your way through hordes of drones as you attempt to survive in a new bullet hell survival shooter.[/p][p]Over the next few months I'll be releasing developer diaries showcasing the games features and progress before releasing a demo, hoping to get you involved as much as possible.[/p][h2]
[b]Stay tuned and Wishlist now for updates![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Pir8Pete[/p]
